name: Lawyer
overview: The Scriptures portray lawyers as individuals who engage Jesus with challenging questions, often to test or tempt Him, as seen when a lawyer asks about inheriting eternal life and who qualifies as a neighbor. Jesus responds by directing them to the law’s core command to love God fully and to love one’s neighbor as oneself, affirming that this is the path to life. This interaction reveals both the lawyer’s desire to justify himself and Jesus’ emphasis on heartfelt obedience rather than mere legalistic knowledge.
